name: Solenne Spire Biosync Executive Command Set
description:
Tier 5 power dressed so quietly that it takes a trained eye to understand what they're seeing. The jacket is bespoke Solenne Atelier — a double-breasted cut in 'eclipse wool,' a material that does not exist in any retail catalog, woven from a proprietary nano-filament blend that actively regulates body temperature within a 0.3-degree tolerance, stiffens slightly at the shoulders when the wearer adopts a dominant posture, and softens at the chest when seated to prevent any visible fabric pull. The color is described internally by Solenne as 'depth-black' — it absorbs ambient light slightly more than standard black fabric, making the wearer appear to occupy slightly more visual space than they physically do. The lapels are peak-cut, wide and sharp, with no visible stitching. No corponation logo appears anywhere on the exterior. Inside the left breast is a privacy-fabric panel that blocks bioscan and thermal imaging — a Tier 5 courtesy, ensuring no meeting-room scanner can read the wearer's heart rate during negotiations. The trousers are cut with a full, authoritative drape and a gene-compatible rear ventilation panel that accommodates a tail-geneware modification with a clean, tailored slit finished in matching eclipse wool binding. Footwear is the Vantrel Bespoke Biosync Oxford, which adapts its fit in real time.

The shirt beneath is silk-analog in warm ivory, with a mandarin collar and no visible closures — it seals via embedded micro-magnets aligned to the wearer's specific measurements. A single piece of jewelry: a wide cuff of brushed dark chrome on the right wrist that functions as a BCI secondary interface node, styled to look purely ornamental. The outfit breathes, adjusts, monitors, and protects. It costs more than most Tier 3 workers earn in three years, and it shows only to people who know what to look for.
materials: brushed dark chrome BCI interface cuff
functionality: Active temperature regulation within 0.3-degree tolerance. Posture-enhancing shoulder matrix that stiffens under power stances. Privacy-fabric bioscan and thermal-imaging block in chest panel. Micro-magnet closures sized to wearer's exact measurements. Gene-compatible tail-vent in rear trouser panel. BCI secondary interface node integrated into wrist cuff. Adaptive oxford footwear synced to gait.
what_it_says: This person does not need to signal status — they ARE status. The absence of logos, the silence of the technology, the perfect drape that never pulls: this is a suit that has been told what the wearer needs and has complied. Wearing this in a room of Tier 3 and 4 workers creates a gravitational effect that has nothing to do with loudness.
worn_by: senior diplomatic liaisons representing sovereign corponations
manufacturer: Solenne Atelier (bespoke Tier 5 house, appointment only, no public storefront)
story_hooks: A character wearing a stolen or borrowed version of this suit enters a Tier 5 space — the biosync oxford begins adapting to the wrong gait profile and the posture matrix stiffens at the wrong moments, subtly marking the wearer as out of place to anyone who knows what to look for.

The privacy-fabric bioscan block triggers a Vantablack security protocol during a building sweep — the wearer becomes the only person in the room whose vitals cannot be confirmed, which is either their intention or a catastrophic accident.

A Tier 3 analyst is tasked with dry-cleaning this suit after a Tier 5 executive leaves it behind — the privacy panel reacts to the cleaning machine's scanner array and locks the jacket's micro-magnet closures permanently shut, trapping something inside.

physical_description.visual_profile: A figure of absolute visual authority — the silhouette is sharp, commanding, almost architectural. The jacket creates an optical illusion of expanded presence; the wearer appears to occupy more space than they physically do. The overall impression is one of controlled power: nothing shouts, everything whispers. The drape is impeccable, the posture supported by intelligent fabric. A Tier 5 executive at rest.
physical_description.fit: Tailored to perfection with no apparent seams. The jacket is structured at the shoulders, softening subtly through the torso. The trousers have an authoritative, full drape with a clean rear ventilation slit for geneware accommodation. The fit is so precise it appears almost second skin — responsive, never constraining.
physical_description.primary_material: Eclipse wool (proprietary Solenne nano-filament blend) for the jacket and trousers. Silk-analog for the mandarin-collar shirt. Brushed dark chrome for the bespoke Biosync wrist cuff. All materials are engineered, not grown.
physical_description.texture: The jacket surface appears impossibly smooth under light — it absorbs rather than reflects, creating a near-matte visual depth. The interior privacy fabric has a barely-perceptible electromagnetic sheen. The shirt is liquid-soft, almost liquid in drape. The cuff is brushed matte, cool to the touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Depth-black for jacket and trousers — a black that seems to swallow light and space. Warm ivory for the silk-analog shirt. The brushed dark chrome cuff provides a singular, understated metallic accent on the right wrist.
physical_description.closures: The jacket is double-breasted with invisible structural integration (no visible buttons). The shirt seals via embedded micro-magnets — no visible closures. The trousers use traditional tailoring with pressure-fit waist integration.
distinctive_features: Depth-black eclipse wool that absorbs ambient light and creates optical presence-expansion
Peak-cut lapels with zero visible stitching
Interior left-breast privacy-fabric panel blocking bioscan and thermal imaging
Gene-compatible rear ventilation slit for tail-geneware, finished in matching eclipse wool binding
Mandarin collar silk-analog shirt with embedded micro-magnet closures
Brushed dark chrome Biosync wrist cuff functioning as secondary BCI interface node
No visible corporate logos or branding anywhere on exterior
Adaptive fabric that stiffens at shoulders in dominant posture, softens at chest when seated
Vantrel Bespoke Biosync Oxfords with adaptive fit
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 bespoke luxury — but displayed with such restraint it appears almost utilitarian to the untrained eye. Only someone who knows Solenne Atelier recognizes the price tag.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is worn by sub-grade operatives, fixers, and black-market power brokers who can afford Tier 5 tailoring but refuse to broadcast it. The wearer is someone who negotiates in boardrooms with corpo executives, yet exists outside official channels. Privacy, adaptation, and quiet authority.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. Solenne Atelier garments are maintained by their owners as investments. There are no wrinkles, no wear patterns — the fabric itself adapts to prevent creasing.

image_prompt: A cyberpunk executive in a Solenne Atelier eclipse-black double-breasted jacket and tailored trousers, wearing a warm ivory mandarin-collar shirt sealed with micro-magnets. A brushed dark chrome Biosync wrist cuff glints faintly on the right wrist. The figure stands in a moody, dimly-lit corporate skybox overlooking the GLMZ, or in a private meeting room with cold blue-grey light. The depth-black fabric seems to absorb the ambient light around it, creating an illusion of expanded presence. The silhouette is sharp, commanding, utterly composed. Midjourney cyberpunk fashion editorial. Dark, authoritative, understated luxury. No logos visible. Shallow depth of field. --ar 2:3 --v 6
